additional_info.subject: Note from RC
additional_info.body:
Location:
Kuressaare, Estonia
Reported behaviour/issue:
Customer stated that
they could not end their charging session one charger ID 170001424 [BCP73l]. They started the transaction from OCPP app at 2024-11-23 14:26:08 with connector 3.
I can see there were to different remotestart transactions and then a stop transaction. But the status of the connector stayed as charging.
The client tried to stop charging from the app and also I tried to from our backend but nothing but a restart worked.
It seems that the car was charging from start of the transaction till the restart. The battery was at 23% at the start and after the restart the client started charging again and it shows 82% now.
The transaction before the restart showed 0 kW
Below is some screenshot from the time stamps:

additional_info.subject: Note to L2
RE: ID0392917-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R1 170001424] Unable to stop charging session CRM:00921001347
additional_info.body:
Hello Sakari,
Hope you are doing well.
After analyzing the issue with the expert team, we confirmed that it is related to poor EcoG firmware in that version. This is also one of the reasons why FW v5 was discontinued. We haven't observed this issue in version v4.0.11, and it did not appear during beta testing of v6.0.1. Therefore, the issue will be resolved in the upcoming v6.0.1 release.
If you need further assistance, please let us know.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
